messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — following the RFC, I prototyped splitting the obs pipeline into two contracts: 'ingest' (raw spans/metrics/logs) and 'enrichment' (billing keys, cost tags). Thoughts?
Priya S: Love the separation. Question: where do sampling decisions live? ingest or enrichment?
Mateo R: My take: sampling at ingest to reduce bytes, but enrichment should be able to reconstruct sampling rationale for cost attribution.
Ingrid L: +1 to Mateo. If enrichment can't see why a trace was sampled, cost allocation will be noisy. We should propagate a sampling_reason field.
Alex K: Agreed. Proposal: ingest emits sampling_reason + sample_rate as part of the minimal envelope. enrichment consumes it and applies cost-weighting.
Priya S: That implies the ingest schema needs two tiny new fields. Any perf hit?
Mateo R: negligible — two small strings/ints. Bigger perf risk is if enrichment needs to fetch external billing metadata synchronously. We should avoid blocking RPCs in the enrichment path.
Kai: Suggestion: enrichment should be idempotent and async. Ingest writes to raw store and a lightweight queue; enrichment workers process queue, attach billing keys, write to cost-index.
Alex K: Sounds good. How do we ensure latency SLOs for dashboards that rely on cost-tagged traces? We might need a best-effort flag and a fallback that marks trace as "untagged" until enrichment finishes.
Ingrid L: Right — dashboards should display eventual consistency. Add field cost_status = [untagged, pending, attached] so UIs can surface freshness.
ops-bot: deploy/notice: env=staging pipeline-enrichment-v2 started at 1977654333
Priya S: For storage, do we keep raw + enriched separately or overwrite? My vote: keep raw immutable and write enriched index. Easier to re-enrich for backwards fixes.
Mateo R: Agree. Also add versioning to enrichment schema so we can run re-enrich jobs when tag logic changes. e.g., enrichment_version = "v1.0".
Alex K: Drafting a minimal ingest schema (we can iterate):
```
{
  trace_id: string,
  spans: [ ... ],
  sample_rate: float,
  sampling_reason: string,
  received_ts: int64
}
```
Alex K: Enrichment output example:
```
{
  trace_id: string,
  billing_key: string,
  cost_status: "pending|attached|untagged",
  enrichment_version: string,
  enriched_ts: int64
}
```
Kai: Nice. Operational notes: add a dead-letter queue for enrichment failures, and a metric obs.enrichment.failures with labels reason, worker.
Priya S: Also need an alert if > 5% of traces stay in pending > 10m. That maps to SLO for cost freshness.
Ingrid L: Ownership — who will own the ingestion schema change? Need one owner to shepherd infra + SDK updates.
Alex K: I can own the ingest schema PR and coordinate with SDK folks. Mateo, can you drive the enrichment workers and DLQ handling?
Mateo R: Yeah, I'll take enrichment. I'll add a short RFC note about async semantics and backfills.
Alex K: Action items: 1) Alex: open ingest schema PR (due +2d). 2) Mateo: prototype enrichment worker + DLQ (due +1w). 3) Priya: write SLO alert proposal (due +3d). 4) Ingrid: update dashboards to show cost_status (due +1w).
Priya S: One more: we should document how to do re-enrichments for historical data (cost and billing audits). I'll add a section in the RFC draft.
Alex K: Great. If nobody objects, I'll post an updated RFC with these changes and call for review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Kai: :+1:
Ingrid L: :thumbsup:
